title: extends and super
summary: Building SavingsAccount on top of BankAccount.

steps.title: Is a
steps.say: `SavingsAccount extends BankAccount` means a savings account **is a** bank account, plus more. It gets every field and method for free.

steps.title: super first
steps.say: The parent sets up its own fields. Your constructor's first line hands it the values it needs.

steps.title: New behavior, reused pieces
steps.say: `applyInterest` uses the inherited `deposit` and `getBalance` instead of changing `balance_` itself.

steps.title: Open SavingsAccount.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `SavingsAccount` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: It may be further down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `public class SavingsAccount` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find public class SavingsAccount with Ctrl+F.

steps.title: Add extends here
steps.say: Change this line to `public class SavingsAccount extends BankAccount {`.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.say: Add the field and the constructor, with `super(...)` on its first line.
